authority_basis.explicit_user_authorization: ok, please go ahead and do that now
authority_basis.reason: macOS replaced the opaque com.apple.provenance value on three pre-existing system parent directories. Subsequent root xattr write/remove operations returned success while macOS retained or reassigned the current value, so historical-byte restoration is neither reliable nor an honest task-owned restoration claim.

evidence_basis.finding: All task-owned product state was retired, but restoration_exact was false solely because com.apple.provenance differed on three pre-existing system parent directories after an attempted timestamp repair.

accepted_platform_baseline.effective_rule: A fresh evidence attempt records the value observed at its pre-mutation baseline. For these exact parent paths only, com.apple.provenance and parent timestamps are record-only OS-managed observations and are excluded from task-owned restoration equality.

still_exact: all task-created or task-modified descendants of the three parent directories
publisher helper, plist, provenance, launchd label, Mach service, processes, and sockets
bounded logical lifecycle records and signer material in the System Keychain
selected prefix and ambient Substrate prefix state
known_hosts, protected sudoers files, fixed limactl, source checkout, attached mirror, and live remote binding
parent directory type, owner, group, mode, ACLs, flags, and every extended attribute other than com.apple.provenance
not_authorized: a blanket exclusion of extended attributes or filesystem metadata
rebaselining or ignoring any task-owned descendant
weakening logical Keychain record deletion or signer absence checks
claiming opaque System.keychain database bytes are task-owned restoration evidence

prohibited_parent_repair_actions: touch or timestamp restoration on the three exact parent directories
xattr write, remove, copy, or replay on the three exact parent directories
SetFile or equivalent metadata repair on the three exact parent directories
any attempt to synthesize or restore a historical com.apple.provenance value
future_evidence_requirements: Capture the three parent identities, security-relevant metadata, timestamps, and com.apple.provenance values before native mutation.
Never mutate a parent merely to repair timestamp or com.apple.provenance parity.
Report any observed parent timestamp or provenance transition without converting it into task-owned restoration failure.
Fail closed on any parent type, ownership, mode, ACL, flags, unexpected extended attribute, or descendant mismatch.
Use a fresh absent nonce-scoped selected prefix and preserve exact task-owned restoration.
